articles.title: pnpm 12.9
articles.summary: This release runs pnpm in StackBlitz WebContainers, adds a per-registry networkConcurrency setting, and records every installed project in the store. It also carries a security fix for pnpm login . Minor Changes pnpm now automatically uses WebAssembly in StackBlitz WebContainers, including when installation scripts are disabled.
